findings.detail: Maturity parser produced 2020-08-31 for an Arrowhead Holdco row whose source maturity is 8/31/2028.

rationale: Class 2 row-level maturity dispute. The bundle's flagged Arrowhead Holdco row reports Agent A parsed value 2020-08-31 against XBRL residual 2028-08-31; the raw schedule row shows maturity 8/31/2028, so the structured/XBRL maturity is correct and the Agent A parsed maturity is a real extraction error.
